verdict.rationale: The docs assign some responsibilities. Adyen verifies onboarded users before payout (KYC). User risk management can be outsourced to Adyen or run with your own rules. Chargeback liability is configurable: chargebacks can be split, accepted on the user's behalf, or booked to the marketplace's 'liable balance account'. That covers part of the KYC and fraud-loss split, but nothing reads as an explicit responsibility matrix. Missing for 10: an explicit platform-vs-Adyen responsibility table, card-network compliance ownership, AML ownership stated as such, seller-misconduct liability, and independent corroboration.
